Secret & Confidential
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C.S.6, Special Branch Registry
REPORT
Date Aug 22 36
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE FILE No. REGISTRY S. D. 7507 3/8/36）
Subject SOLOVIEFF, E. --- General Information.
Made by D.S. Kourjansky. Forwarded by Em Gran DSI.
Whilst on the way to Tsingtao on board the s.s.
"Tsingtao Maru" on August 4, 1936, I overheard one of the
passengers in his conversation openly declaring himself deeply
sympathetic towards the Soviet. He stated that he was a
merchant (without disclosing the nature of his business) and
that he possessed a Latvian passport. Asked why he did not
return to Soviet Russia since he held such admiration for the
country and its government, he replied that he had spent several
years in a Solovki Detention camp and that nowadays he preferred
to stay abroad. His answers in the main were vague and did
not show the reason for his alleged detention in the above
mentioned camp.
Careful enquiries made by the undersigned revealed
that the man's name is Emelian SOLOVIEFF and that he is in
possession of a Chinese passport No.3395 issued to him in
Tsingtao on 17.7.36, good for travelling between Chefoo,
Tientsin, Dairen, Harbin and Shanghai. In this document he
is described as a Russian.
Enquiries in Tsingtao showed that his statements
about his possession of certain boarding houses and a motor
car in that city were untrue. It is known in Tsingtao that
in the early part of this year he attempted to introduce
Soviet films there but for some reason the project failed.
I have carefully questioned several people in Tsingtao
regarding the nature of Solovieff's business but none appear
to possess any definite knowledge beyond the fact that he
travels a great deal and that he left Tsingtao for Chefoo
in August.
F.S. Voschikoff attached to Hongkew, who was travelling
（印：24 AUG. 1936 CRIME BRANCH）

秘密及机密
上海公共租界工部局警务处
C.S.6，特别股登记处
报告
日期：1936年8月22日
（印：上海公共租界工部局档案号 登记处 S. D. 7507 1936年8月3日）
事由：索洛维耶夫，E. (SOLOVIEFF, E.) —— 一般情报。
制作人：D.S. 库尔扬斯基 (Kourjansky)。呈报人：Em Gran DSI。
1936年8月4日，在乘坐“青岛丸”号 (s.s. "Tsingtao Maru") 轮船前往青岛的途中，我无意中听到一名乘客在谈话中公开宣称自己对苏联深表同情。他声称自己是一名商人（未透露其业务性质），并持有一本拉脱维亚护照。当被问及既然对该国及其政府如此钦佩，为何不返回苏俄时，他回答说他在索洛韦茨基 (Solovki) 拘留营度过了数年，如今更倾向于滞留国外。他的回答大体含糊不清，并未说明据称在上述拘留营中被拘禁的原因。
经具名人仔细查访，查明该男子名为埃梅利安·索洛维耶夫 (Emelian SOLOVIEFF)，持有一本中国护照，号码为3395，于1936年7月17日在青岛签发给他，适用于在烟台、天津、大连、哈尔滨和上海之间旅行。在该文件中，他被描述为俄国人。
在青岛进行的查访显示，他关于在该市拥有若干寄宿处和一辆汽车的说法不实。青岛方面知悉，今年年初他曾试图在当地引进苏联电影，但因故项目失败。
我就索洛维耶夫的业务性质在青岛仔细询问了数人，但除了知道他经常旅行以及他于八月离开青岛前往烟台外，似乎无人掌握任何确切信息。
隶属虹口巡捕房的 F.S. 沃希科夫 (Voschikoff) 当时正乘坐同一艘轮船
（印：1936年8月24日 刑事股）
档案
DR

Solovieff whose description is as follows, has
no record locally :-
Aged 36, complexion fair, face long, hair (blonde)
brushed back, mole in the middle of the left cheek, one gold
tooth in right side of lower jaw, height about 5' 10", rather
sturdy build.
